d: Long, flowing amethyst-purple hair with straight bangs and two thick, curving pigtails is topped with a large white and red bow. The sharp, almond-shaped eyes are a bright cyan blue, set on a youthful, mature face with pointed elven ears. A slender build is dressed in a white and crimson tiered dress with ruffled hems, a black bodice, and silver armored gauntlets and boots. A long, thin purple tail extends from behind, and the figure holds a large, ornate red and silver spear.
